answer: Anchor each vote to the epoch's public beacon: to vote, an identity locks stake and dyes it with a pigment derived from that beacon value, a stain valid for one epoch only. The same funds cannot be dyed twice, so a Sybil farmer cannot reuse one bankroll across puppets - the old fable of one person casting many votes dies at the dye vat. Each extra puppet needs its own freshly locked, separately stained stake, and unstaining takes a full epoch, while an honest agent dyes once and votes at full weight.
